evidence_set: Three of the four adjunct-role trials combined the strategies with personalized normative feedback (Table 2; editors' count). The authors caution that the apparently larger adjunct effects cannot be interpreted as evidence of superiority because subgroups included relatively few studies and could not fully account for intervention intensity, delivery format or other components; these estimates therefore do not isolate the strategies' contribution. The main outcome pools, rather than established subgroup sizes, contain six to nine trials (Results 3.4). The authors describe subgroup findings as exploratory and identify self-reported outcomes, attrition and predominantly university-student samples as limitations.
